card.headline: *Central* open the season with a win.

caption:
Central start the new season with a win. 🏀
86-78 over NSA in the opening game of the Lebanese basketball league.

المركزية بلّش الموسم بفوز 🏀
86-78 على NSA بافتتاح الدوري اللبناني لكرة السلة.

Source: Lebanese Basketball Federation
@clubcentraljounieh @flb_official
#SportsWireLB #LebaneseBasketball
alt: Result card: Lebanon Basketball League, round 1, final, Saturday 24 October: Central 86, NSA 78. Central open the season with a win.
